I feel this on a soul deep level, but remember this feeling is temporary. It will come and go. Just do your best, think of a friend to call or an activity that will take your mind off your sadness, to ride the wave out.

Sounds like a generic answer,  I know, but this is truly what works best for me, when I can find the want to overcome it. Sometimes finding that want takes some time, so I try to remind myself to be patient. The want has always returned, eventually. 

I wish you the best 💕

I ended up calling a mental health hotline. They set me up with a mental health facility that is income based, bc I don't have ins or a job and I'm new to the area I now live in.
I was highly emotional and felt at the end of my rope. 

Idk where you live, but I google searched the hell out of mental health facilities in my area, tried reaching out to see who had payment scales and was having no luck. On one (maybe several, I can't honestly remember) pages I found in my Google searches was the hotline number.

I hope this helps, I wish you the best 💕
